What is FreeQrly?

FreeQrly is a free online QR code generator. It creates static QR codes for links, text, WiFi, vCards, SMS, calls, and locations — entirely in your browser, with no account and no fees. Dynamic codes, which you can edit after printing, need a free sign-in.
Yes. Every feature — including logo upload, batch generation, and high-resolution export — is free, with no trial and no watermarks. Static codes need no sign-up; dynamic codes need a free sign-in.
Do FreeQrly QR codes expire?
No. FreeQrly only generates static QR codes, which encode the destination directly in the pattern. They never expire and require no subscription.
Does FreeQrly track my QR codes or my data?

Static codes are generated locally in your browser using JavaScript; your content is never uploaded to a server, and there is no scan tracking. Dynamic codes store only the destination you set, so they can be edited later, plus anonymous scan counts.
What languages does FreeQrly support?
Ten: English, Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic (with right-to-left layout), Portuguese, French, Russian, German, and Japanese.
